name: LLAS 5622
title: The Historical Literature of Latin America
description: (Also offered as HIST 5622.) The history and historiography of postcolonial Latin America, with particular attention to shifting notions of race, nation, and citizenship, and the emergence of new spatial configurations and social groups pressing for political inclusion and economic rights. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
